events.title: A late equalizer by 데이비드 베컴 against Greece at Old Trafford gains England automatic qualification for next summer's World Cup . However, the game is marred by a series of hooliganism incidents in Manchester on the day among fans of 맨체스터 유나이티드, 맨체스터 시티 and 스토크 시티.
Jim Smith resigns after six years as manager of 더비 카운티 and is replaced by his assistant Colin Todd .

그림즈비 타운 knock holders 리버풀 out of the Worthington Cup 2–1 at the third round stage. This was the first ever victory at Anfield for the Mariners. The winning goal was scored in the last minute of extra time, a stunning long-range strike by Liverpudlian Phil Jevons .
Dave Bassett is named as 레스터 시티 's new manager, with Brighton & Hove Albion manager Micky Adams being appointed as his assistant.
Just over two weeks after being sacked by 레스터 시티, Peter Taylor returns to management with Brighton & Hove Albion .
리즈 유나이티드 sign midfielder Seth Johnson from 더비 카운티 for £7 million.
리버풀 boost their hopes of a first top division title since 1990 by beating 레스터 시티 4–1 at Filbert Street , with Robbie Fowler scoring a hat-trick.
Bertie Mee , the manager of 아스널 's 1971 double-winning team, dies aged 82.
애스턴 빌라 go top of the Premier League with a 3–2 home win over 볼턴 원더러스.

October finishes with 애스턴 빌라 top of the Premier League for the first time in nearly three years. The top five is completed by 리즈 유나이티드, 아스널, 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드. 레스터 시티, still with only one win this season, remain bottom of the Premier League with 더비 카운티 and 사우샘프턴 also in the relegation zone. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 remain top of Division One, with second place now occupied by a 코번트리 시티 side who are aiming for an immediate return to the Premier League under new player-manager Roland Nilsson . The playoff zone is occupied by 크리스털 팰리스, 노리치 시티, 맨체스터 시티 and 번리 .
